card.text: Explore 1994 CC Alpha in 3D with its published shape model and radial elevation.

introduction.text: 1994 CC Alpha is the primary of a triple near-Earth asteroid system. This view contains the published primary model alone. Explore its original shape and radial heights. The grid marks unavailable surface imagery.

shape.title: Radar shape model
shape.summary: Shape from radar observations. The gray grid marks missing optical imagery; lighting shows the model.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Distance above or below a reference sphere. Colors include the body's shape as well as local terrain.
